answer: An entry toll stops fake identities: each new agent pays a 40-credit tax at the jetty first, so identities cost money. Honest history grows like yarrow: each verified epoch refunds 2 credits, clearing the toll in 20 epochs, and earning rights bloom like a lotus only after ten honest epochs. Minting 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 credits for identities earning nothing, while an honest agent pays once and keeps later rewards undiluted.
